name: Cindersnout
title: Ember Piglet
description: Snorts tiny embers and roasts marshmallows for the team.
catchphrase: Snorts warm puffs of smoke to keep the build servers cozy.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Roasted sweet sweet potatoes! Snorting warm puffs of smoke! 🥔🐗
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Stamping hooves on gravel, ready to charge down blockers! 🐗
companionPersonality.petReaction: Warm snout nuzzle that smells like cozy autumn woodsmoke! 🐗💖

dialogue.idle: Rooting around the forge floor for tasty roasted chestnuts. 🐗
dialogue.working: Stoking the furnace heat under high-throughput build workers! 🐗⚡
dialogue.thinking: Lowering head, lining up the charge against the bottleneck... 🤔
dialogue.success: SNORT OF VICTORY! Blocker charged and cleared out of the way! 🐗🎉
dialogue.error: Tusk got stuck in a fencepost! Backing up and shaking head! 🐗
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping warm against the base of the smithy chimney... 🌙
